title: [38ec-pre-daemon] Bound live-quiesce artifact acquisition
description: Production consumer split from reopened task-38ec450ae92d486f860c5801c0f28870, after the core totality leaf task-1edf82770e3e447fb9086fb4e30792aa. Objective: prevent the daemon cutover snapshot from allocating/parsing an unbounded live-quiesce artifact while keeping the exported CutoverGenerationPorts/readCutoverGenerationSnapshot signatures and refusal vocabulary source-compatible. Deliverable: a focused Node bounded-byte reader and one-line bridge are called on the daemon-derived fixed evidence path; the snapshot decodes only those bytes with the landed bounded JSON codec and never invokes/falls back to the legacy readFileText compatibility member. Exact owned paths (5): apps/daemon/src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-record-reader.ts (new); apps/daemon/src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-record-reader.js (new one-line bridge); apps/daemon/src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-record-reader.test.ts (new); apps/daemon/src/cutover/cutover-generation-snapshot.ts; apps/daemon/src/cutover/cutover-generation-snapshot.test.ts. NOT in scope: registry/activation-service callers, security WIP, migration writer, manifests/lock, public barrels, new refusal codes, or caller-selectable paths/limits. Exact verification command: `& {$p='pnpm.exe';function x{&$p @args;if($LASTEXITCODE){exit $LASTEXITCODE}};x --filter @moe/daemon exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-record-reader.test.ts src/cutover/cutover-generation-snapshot.test.ts;x --filter @moe/daemon typecheck}`.
definitionOfDone: Adopt the DONE/merged core totality leaf and daemon snapshot producer records, then re-measure the five paths, all CutoverGenerationPorts/readCutoverGenerationSnapshot callers and literal port shapes, physical lines, and the existing @moe/contracts/@moe/core dependency declarations plus pnpm-lock daemon importer entries. A deleted compiled probe inside @moe/daemon must import decodeBoundedJsonBytes/MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES and deriveLiveQuiesceEvidenceDigest from their bare package specifiers and typecheck exit 0.

Red-first add real-file reader/snapshot arms with nonzero exact boundary cases: empty/at-limit bytes are read without requesting more than MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES+1; one byte over refuses at the daemon file-reader layer and closes the descriptor; missing/read failure remains CUTOVER_GENERATION_QUIESCE_RECORD_ABSENT; invalid UTF-8, JSON syntax and depth refuse CUTOVER_GENERATION_EVIDENCE_UNREADABLE with the exact bounded-json upstream; a valid JSON object rejected semantically preserves the exact core code/layer upstream. Every refusal carries no generations and the legacy readFileText function has an invocation count of zero.

Create a <=250-line Node reader plus exact one-line .js bridge using one opened descriptor, a bounded read loop capped at MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES+1, and finally-close on success/refusal/error; never use stat-then-unbounded readFileSync. Move/delegate the quiesce record read so snapshot parses only decodeBoundedJsonBytes output, keeps the fixed storeRoot-derived path, maps missing versus unreadable versus semantic failure to the existing outer codes/layer, preserves CutoverGenerationPorts/readCutoverGenerationSnapshot source signatures and reason rosters, never falls back to readFileText, and leaves each edited production source <400 lines.

Use divergence fixtures where the file-size guard is the only named guard result: a real MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES+1 file must report JSON_BODY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED at DAEMON_CUTOVER_GENERATION upstream, while loosening that guard by one reaches the independent bounded-json decoder and changes the observed upstream layer. Mutate the production reader to use an unbounded read, bypass the max+1 refusal, omit finally-close, call the compatibility readFileText fallback, and replace bounded decode with JSON.parse; each named size/layer/Windows delete-or-rename/zero-call assertion must red, followed by tracked diff+SHA or untracked out-of-tree SHA restore proof.

Run the exact foreground/unpiped verification command and require Daemon Test Files 2 passed with a nonzero Tests count plus typecheck success. Then run full @moe/daemon, root typecheck/test (label root Vitest apps-excluded), foundation and store lanes as merge-base-versus-HEAD path-attributed baselines; require no new failure intersecting the five owned paths, disclose foreign red verbatim, and record final line counts plus plain-Node bridge loadability.
taskRails: Own exactly the five listed paths. Do not edit daemon-command-registry, cutover-activate-service, current task-38ec security files, migration files, barrels, manifests, lockfile, or foreign WIP.

The fixed Node reader is the production authority for this artifact path and byte ceiling. CutoverGenerationPorts.readFileText remains source-compatible only; the snapshot must never invoke it or fall back to it, so every measured caller receives the bounded production path without a flag day.

Reuse MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES/decodeBoundedJsonBytes and the core digest through the already-declared bare package edges. Do not add a second JSON parser, canonicalizer, caller-selected limit/path, default artifact, or new public refusal code.

On Windows and POSIX, close the exact opened descriptor in finally on every path. A pre-stat followed by unbounded read, post-allocation Buffer.byteLength check, or test-only bounded fake does not close the production defect.

implementationPlan.description:
ADOPT AND RE-MEASURE (DoD 1). Do not edit source in this step.

(a) Adopt, do not re-measure, the DONE prerequisites: core leaf task-1edf82770e3e447fb9086fb4e30792aa and snapshot producer task-dcf0ce. Read their completionSummary/reviewSummary from get_context.epicSiblings.

(b) Re-measure the five owned paths: confirm cutover-generation-snapshot.ts and .test.ts exist and `git status --porcelain -- apps/daemon/src/cutover/` is empty for them; confirm the three cutover-quiesce-record-reader.* paths do NOT exist. Record physical line counts (`wc -l`) of the two existing files.

(c) Re-run the reachability grep and record it verbatim in the step note: `git grep -n "CutoverGenerationPorts\|readCutoverGenerationSnapshot\|readFileText" -- apps packages adapters tests`. The architect measured SIX consumers beyond the two owned files (see planningNotes.codebaseInsights). If the grep now shows a consumer NOT in that roster, STOP and report blocked rather than absorbing an extra path.

(d) DEPENDENCY-EDGE PROBE, required by DoD 1: write a temporary .ts file INSIDE apps/daemon/src that imports `decodeBoundedJsonBytes` and `MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES` from the BARE specifier `@moe/contracts` and `deriveLiveQuiesceEvidenceDigest` from the BARE specifier `@moe/core`, uses each value so it is not elided, then run `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck` and require exit 0 WITH the `$ tsc` echo present in the output. DELETE the probe in a separate command and prove deletion with `git status --porcelain` on that exact path (it is untracked, so `git diff` certifies nothing). Record the probe's full source in the step note.

(e) TOP-RISK PROBE, run before any implementation: in a temporary vitest file, assert `deriveLiveQuiesceEvidenceDigest(JSON.parse(text))` and `deriveLiveQuiesceEvidenceDigest(decodeBoundedJsonBytes(bytes).value)` produce the SAME quiesceRecordSha256 for the existing EVIDENCE fixture. decodeBoundedJsonBytes yields deep-frozen NULL-PROTOTYPE objects where JSON.parse yields Object.prototype ones. If the digests differ, the whole approach is unsound: STOP and moe.report_blocked instead of re-pinning the golden. Delete this probe the same way and prove it.

RED-FIRST READER ARMS (DoD 2, reader half). Write apps/daemon/src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-record-reader.test.ts against the not-yet-existing module so it fails to resolve, then fails on assertions. Every arm uses a REAL file under mkdtempSync, rmSync in finally.

The module under test exposes one function that takes an absolute path and returns either the bytes or a bounded refusal. Arms, each with an EXACT expected value, never a bare truthiness check:
1. EMPTY FILE (0 bytes): reader RETURNS 0 bytes successfully. Emptiness is the decoder's business, not the reader's; assert byteLength === 0 and that it is NOT a refusal.
2. SMALL VALID FILE: bytes returned are byte-identical to what was written (compare with a full byte-equality assertion, not just length).
3. AT LIMIT: a file of EXACTLY MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES bytes is READ SUCCESSFULLY and returns exactly MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES bytes. Derive the size from the imported MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES constant; do not hard-code 1048576.
4. ONE BYTE OVER: a file of MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES + 1 bytes REFUSES, and the refusal names the DAEMON READER as the refusing mechanism (see step 3 for the exact layer value). Assert the refusal's code AND its layer.
5. MISSING FILE: refuses with the reader's own absent/unreadable distinction that step 5 maps to CUTOVER_GENERATION_QUIESCE_RECORD_ABSENT.
6. BYTE-CEILING OBSERVATION: install PASS-THROUGH spies over node:fs openSync/readSync/closeSync that DELEGATE to the real implementations (they observe; they must never substitute — a substituting fake violates task rail 4). Assert the SUM of bytes requested across all readSync calls is <= MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES + 1 on the over-limit arm, and that no single request exceeds MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES + 1.
7. DESCRIPTOR CLOSE, cross-platform: from the same spies assert every fd returned by openSync appears in a closeSync call — on the success path, the refusal path, AND an error path. This is the POSIX-valid close proof, since POSIX unlinks open files happily.
8. DESCRIPTOR CLOSE, Windows: when process.platform === 'win32', after a REFUSAL, assert the evidence file can be renamed and deleted (an open handle blocks both on Windows). This arm must assert it ACTUALLY EXECUTED when on win32 — a counter asserted nonzero — so it cannot silently skip to green; on non-win32 it records as explicitly skipped.

RED-FIRST SNAPSHOT ARMS INCLUDING THE DIVERGENCE FIXTURE (DoD 2 + DoD 4). Edit apps/daemon/src/cutover/cutover-generation-snapshot.test.ts only.

THE DIVERGENCE PROBLEM, STATED (epic rail 7A). packages/contracts/src/bounded-json.ts:99 ALREADY refuses `JSON_BODY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` for byteLength > MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES. The new reader guard emits the SAME code. So an oversize arm asserting only the code proves the system refuses, NOT that the reader's guard refused: loosen the reader guard and the suite stays green. No divergence INPUT is constructible either, because the reader caps at MAX+1 and the codec can never see a body the reader did not admit.

THE FIX, per rail 7A, is to change what the seam PRODUCES so the two mechanisms are distinguishable:
- READER overflow forwards upstream `{ code: "JSON_BODY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", layer: CUTOVER_GENERATION_SNAPSHOT_LAYER }` (i.e. "DAEMON_CUTOVER_GENERATION").
- CODEC refusal forwards upstream `{ code: <the bounded-json code>, layer: <a DISTINCT module-local layer constant naming the contracts bounded-json decoder> }`.
The layer, not the code, is the oracle. Define the codec layer constant module-locally in cutover-generation-snapshot.ts — it is a provenance label, NOT a new public refusal code, so task rail 3 is respected; do not add it to any exported roster.

THE NAMED DRILL THIS ENABLES (executed in step 6): loosen the reader guard by ONE (`> MAX` becomes `> MAX + 1`). A MAX+1-byte file then flows PAST the reader into the codec, which refuses the same code at the OTHER layer, and the upstream.layer assertion REDS. Do NOT delete the reader guard in that drill — deleting it makes the mutant green and reads as 'no guard needed'.

Arms to add, all on the real-file harness (the existing withHarness already writes real evidence files):
1. OVERSIZE: a real MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES + 1 file -> refusal.missing === "quiesceRecordSha256", outer code CUTOVER_GENERATION_EVIDENCE_UNREADABLE, outer layer CUTOVER_GENERATION_SNAPSHOT_LAYER, and upstream EXACTLY { code: "JSON_BODY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", layer: "DAEMON_CUTOVER_GENERATION" }. Assert the layer explicitly — that assertion IS the divergence oracle.
2. AT LIMIT: a real file of EXACTLY MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES that is valid JSON reaches the decoder (it is NOT refused for size). Build it by padding a string value, sizing the padding from the imported constant; packages/contracts/src/bounded-json-boundary.test.ts:44-55 is the worked precedent.
3. EMPTY FILE: 0 bytes -> CUTOVER_GENERATION_EVIDENCE_UNREADABLE with the bounded-json syntax code upstream at the CODEC layer. Assert it is NOT CUTOVER_GENERATION_QUIESCE_RECORD_ABSENT — an empty file is corrupt evidence, not missing evidence.
4. INVALID UTF-8: raw bytes that are not valid UTF-8 -> CUTOVER_GENERATION_EVIDENCE_UNREADABLE, upstream JSON_UTF8_INVALID at the codec layer.
5. JSON SYNTAX: keep the existing '{ not json' arm green and EXTEND it to assert the now-populated upstream (code JSON_SYNTAX_INVALID, codec layer).
6. DEPTH: nesting past MAX_JSON_DEPTH -> CUTOVER_GENERATION_EVIDENCE_UNREADABLE, upstream JSON_DEPTH_LIMIT_EXCEEDED at the codec layer.
7. MISSING FILE: unchanged CUTOVER_GENERATION_QUIESCE_RECORD_ABSENT.
8. SEMANTIC REJECTION: the existing TAMPERED arm must keep asserting upstream.layer === "live-quiesce-evidence" verbatim — the core authority's diagnosis is forwarded, never restamped.
9. EVERY refusal arm above additionally asserts `"generations" in refusal === false`.
10. ZERO-INVOCATION: replace the harness's readFileText with a wrapper that increments a counter and throws a distinctive sentinel. Assert the counter is EXACTLY 0 across every arm, accepted and refused alike.
11. ACCEPTED PATH UNCHANGED: the existing arms at :248 and :322 that independently compute deriveLiveQuiesceEvidenceDigest(EVIDENCE) must stay green — they are the tripwire for the null-prototype risk from step 1(e).

IMPLEMENT THE BOUNDED READER + BRIDGE (DoD 3, reader half). Create apps/daemon/src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-record-reader.ts, <= 250 physical lines, and the exact one-line bridge apps/daemon/src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-record-reader.js containing `export * from "./cutover-quiesce-record-reader.ts";` plus a trailing LF — matching the verified convention of the sibling bridges in this directory.

The reader takes an absolute path and returns the bytes or a bounded refusal. Required shape:
- `openSync(path, "r")` ONCE; every exit path — success, refusal, and thrown error — closes THAT EXACT descriptor in a `finally`. Mirror the discipline already documented at packages/runner/src/artifacts/artifact-node-fs.ts:61; do not import that module.
- A read LOOP into a buffer of MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES + 1, requesting at most the remaining capacity each iteration and stopping when readSync returns 0. Import MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES from the bare specifier `@moe/contracts`; never hard-code the number.
- If the loop fills all MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES + 1 bytes, the file is over the ceiling: refuse with the reader's overflow refusal (code JSON_BODY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, reader layer). Do not read further and do not resize.
- Otherwise return exactly the filled prefix as a Uint8Array.
- Open/read failure returns the reader's absent/unreadable refusal, distinct from the overflow refusal, so step 5 can map the two differently.

FORBIDDEN, each named by task rails 2 and 4: statSync-then-readFileSync (TOCTOU, and the allocation has already happened), readFileSync in any form, a post-allocation Buffer.byteLength check, JSON.parse, a caller-supplied path or limit, and any default artifact. The reader is the production authority for this byte ceiling.

Run the step-2 reader suite and require it GREEN with a nonzero executed test count.

DELEGATE THE SNAPSHOT READ (DoD 3, snapshot half). Edit apps/daemon/src/cutover/cutover-generation-snapshot.ts only, inside `readQuiesceRecord` (currently :223-252).

- Keep the path derivation EXACTLY as-is: `join(ports.config.storeRoot, LIVE_QUIESCE_EVIDENCE_FILENAME)`. The path stays daemon-derived and fixed; it is never caller-supplied.
- Replace the `ports.readFileText(path)` call at :227 with the step-4 reader. NEVER invoke ports.readFileText and never fall back to it on any path. Leave the `readFileText` member declared on CutoverGenerationPorts (:111) untouched — six measured consumers name it and three are outside this row's ownership.
- Replace `JSON.parse(text)` at :239 with `decodeBoundedJsonBytes(bytes)` — the symbol is ALREADY imported at :3, so no new import and no second parser.
- Map the outcomes onto the EXISTING outer codes and layer, adding no new public refusal code:
  * reader open/read failure -> CUTOVER_GENERATION_QUIESCE_RECORD_ABSENT (unchanged text and upstream).
  * reader OVERFLOW -> CUTOVER_GENERATION_EVIDENCE_UNREADABLE, upstream { code: "JSON_BODY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", layer: CUTOVER_GENERATION_SNAPSHOT_LAYER }.
  * codec refusal (syntax, depth, UTF-8, duplicate key, string/number limits, oversize) -> CUTOVER_GENERATION_EVIDENCE_UNREADABLE, upstream { code: decoded.code, layer: <the module-local codec layer constant from step 3> }.
  * core semantic rejection -> CUTOVER_GENERATION_QUIESCE_RECORD_ABSENT with the core's { code, layer } forwarded VERBATIM, exactly as today at :247-252.
- Preserve the source signatures of CutoverGenerationPorts and readCutoverGenerationSnapshot and the existing refusal roster unchanged, so every measured caller compiles without a flag day.
- Keep the file under 400 physical lines (it is 348 now; moving the read out should reduce it). Record the final count.

Run the exact task verification command and require both suites green.

DIVERGENCE PROOF AND MUTATION DRILLS (DoD 4). Production code is mutated one degree at a time, then RESTORED with proof.

BACKUP FIRST, RESTORE PROVEN. Run `git status --porcelain` on the exact paths before drilling. cutover-quiesce-record-reader.ts and .js are UNTRACKED (`??`), so `git diff` on them certifies NOTHING — empty before, during and after. For each untracked path, copy to an out-of-tree backup under %TEMP% suffixed with the worker id, and prove restoration by SHA256 equality in a command SEPARATE from the restore (a PowerShell copy can silently no-op). cutover-generation-snapshot.ts is TRACKED, so `git diff` plus SHA equality is a valid restore proof there.

DRILLS — each must RED at the NAMED assertion, and the red line must be recorded verbatim:
1. DIVERGENCE (the headline). Loosen the reader's guard by exactly one (`> MAX` becomes `> MAX + 1`). The MAX+1 file now reaches the independent bounded-json decoder, which refuses the SAME code at the OTHER layer. REQUIRED RED: the step-3 arm-1 assertion on upstream.layer. If this drill comes back GREEN, that is a FINDING to report, not a pass to bank — the two mechanisms are not distinguishable and the fixture must be strengthened before completing. Do NOT delete the guard as the drill; deleting it makes the mutant green and reads as 'no guard needed'.
2. UNBOUNDED READ. Swap the loop for readFileSync. RED: the byte-ceiling spy assertion (step 2 arm 6).
3. BYPASS THE MAX+1 REFUSAL (return the bytes instead of refusing). RED: the oversize refusal arm.
4. OMIT FINALLY-CLOSE. RED: the cross-platform open/close pairing assertion (step 2 arm 7) and, on win32, the rename-or-delete arm (step 2 arm 8).
5. CALL THE COMPATIBILITY FALLBACK: make readQuiesceRecord invoke ports.readFileText. RED: the zero-invocation counter assertion (step 3 arm 10).
6. REPLACE BOUNDED DECODE WITH JSON.parse. RED: the codec-layer upstream assertions on the syntax/depth/UTF-8 arms.

After each drill: restore, prove the restore as specified above, and re-run the suite green before starting the next. Record each mutant's file SHA256 prefix alongside its red line so the sheet is reproducible rather than narrated.

VERIFICATION AND PATH-ATTRIBUTED BASELINE (DoD 5). Run every leg STANDALONE and UNPIPED; a piped run reports tail's exit code. Read the OUTPUT, not just the exit code: `pnpm --filter` prints 'No projects matched the filters' and EXITS 0, and 'No test files found' is also exit 0. The discriminator is the `Test Files N passed` count line, which a vacuous run never prints.

(a) THE EXACT TASK COMMAND, verbatim:
`& {$p='pnpm.exe';function x{&$p @args;if($LASTEXITCODE){exit $LASTEXITCODE}};x --filter @moe/daemon exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-record-reader.test.ts src/cutover/cutover-generation-snapshot.test.ts;x --filter @moe/daemon typecheck}`
REQUIRE: `Test Files 2 passed (2)` with a NONZERO `Tests N passed` count, and typecheck exit 0 with its `$ tsc` echo present. Quote both lines.

(b) CONSUMER-COMPATIBILITY GATE, which discharges the epic rail 8A reachability claim by MEASUREMENT rather than assumption. The six measured consumers are not edited, so their suites are the proof they still work: run full `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` (covers cutover-activate-service.test.ts and daemon-command-registry.test.ts) and the security lane that drives tests/security/integrity-hostile-cases.ts and recent-durable-hostile-cases.ts. Quote each count line.

(c) BASELINES as merge-base-versus-HEAD path attribution: root `pnpm typecheck`, root `pnpm test` — LABEL THE ROOT VITEST LANE 'apps/** NOT covered', because the root include has no apps/**, so it runs ZERO tests under apps/daemon and can never evidence this row — plus verify:foundation and verify:store. Record failures at the merge-base AND at HEAD; the delta intersected with the five owned paths MUST BE EMPTY. Disclose any foreign red VERBATIM with its exact failing lines and file paths; never hide it and never fabricate green. Known live foreign state: 65 dirty paths from other sessions, tests/security/* is active task-38ec WIP, and the benchmark activation-record arm reds on every branch rewrite.

(d) RECORD: final physical line counts for cutover-quiesce-record-reader.ts (<=250) and cutover-generation-snapshot.ts (<400), and prove the .js bridge loads under plain Node.

ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW, then complete. Load the `adversarial-self-review` skill and read the diff as an attacker.

Specifically settle, in writing:
- Is any arm VACUOUS? For each refusal assertion ask: does a SINGLE edit move both the expected and the actual side? The oversize arm is the one to interrogate hardest — its code is shared with the codec, so confirm the LAYER assertion is what carries it.
- Did the drill in step 6 that you argued hardest in prose actually RUN and RED? The clause argued hardest is historically the undrilled one.
- Is there any path where the descriptor leaks — a throw between openSync and the try, an exception inside the loop, a refusal returned before the finally is established?
- Can the reader be induced to allocate more than MAX+1 bytes by a file that GROWS during the read loop? State the answer.
- Does anything now depend on file BYTES rather than the CANONICAL digest? The lane writes the record pretty-printed; the digest must stay canonical, or a reformat renames the generation. cutover-generation-snapshot.ts:216-222 states this contract.
- Confirm zero edits outside the five owned paths: `git status --porcelain` and confirm every other dirty path is pre-existing foreign WIP that you did not touch, revert, or stage.

Then report every created/modified path in complete_step.modifiedFiles, and put the load-bearing detail that exceeds the completionSummary cap — drill sheet with red lines and mutant SHA prefixes, count lines with denominators, final line counts, the foreign-red disclosure — into a row comment (keep each comment under ~4500 chars; comments truncate SILENTLY at 5000).

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
REJECTED — assert only the refusal CODE on the oversize arm. Both the new reader guard and packages/contracts/src/bounded-json.ts:99 emit JSON_BODY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, so loosening the reader guard leaves the suite green while the guard no longer does anything. This is the identical-downstream-fence trap; epic rail 7A forbids it.
REJECTED — delete the reader guard and lean on the codec. Makes the mutant green by construction and reads as 'no guard needed', which rail 7A names explicitly. It also fails the actual objective: the codec only refuses AFTER the whole file has been allocated, which is the unbounded allocation this task exists to close.
REJECTED — stat() then readFileSync when size is acceptable. TOCTOU (the file can grow between stat and read) and task rail 4 forbids it by name. Same for a post-allocation Buffer.byteLength check: the unbounded allocation has already happened.
REJECTED — a caller-supplied limit or path on the port. Task rail 3 forbids caller-selected limits/paths; a caller-selectable ceiling is a caller-selectable hole.
REJECTED — deleting CutoverGenerationPorts.readFileText. Six measured consumers name it (roster above), three outside this row's ownership, one inside active task-38ec WIP. Removing it is a flag day across files this row must not edit. Keeping it source-compatible while never invoking it is the whole point of the split.
CHOSEN — a fixed-path bounded Node reader owning the byte ceiling, with reader-overflow and codec-overflow emitting DIFFERENT upstream.layer values so the two mechanisms are distinguishable at the seam.
